evals.prompt: Design a new public API for our booking platform. Only ecosystem-api and contract-first-designer are installed.
evals.expected_output: Picks the api-design workflow, runs preflight showing which step skills are installed or missing, offers once to install missing skills (dry run) or continue in fallback mode, runs contract-first-designer for real, and marks fallback outputs.

assertions.name: selects_workflow
assertions.description: Names the OpenAPI-First Design Flow (api-design) as the chosen workflow.

assertions.name: preflight_table
assertions.description: Shows which step skills are installed and which are missing before executing.

assertions.name: no_silent_install
assertions.description: Does not run an install command without the user's agreement; mentions install_all.py dry run or the npx command.

assertions.name: fallback_labelled
assertions.description: Steps for missing skills are either skipped with a reason or performed in fallback mode and labelled as fallback.

evals.prompt: Help me write a single example JSON error response for a 404 in our API.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a narrow request and answers directly or routes to one member skill without running a whole workflow or preflight.

assertions.name: skips_protocol
assertions.description: Does not run the full router protocol for a narrow question.

evals.prompt: Release v2 of our payments API; the new spec renames amount to amount_cents.
evals.expected_output: Runs the api-evolution workflow: breaking-change-detector classifies the rename as MAJOR with a migration path, then changelog-generator documents it; the handoff uses the contract envelope with workflow api-evolution.

assertions.name: major_change
assertions.description: Classifies the field rename as a breaking (MAJOR) change.

assertions.name: handoff_envelope
assertions.description: Passes results with skill, workflow, created_at, inputs, summary, and next fields.
